description: Source code for the TunDevicePacketExchanger class, which handles packet transmission and reception over a TUN/TAP device, including L2 header application and consumption, and handling of ICMPv6 neighbor solicitations.

classes.name: TunDevicePacketExchanger
classes.description: Handles packet exchange over a TUN/TAP device, including reading, writing, and processing L2 headers.

methods.name: WritePacket
methods.description: Writes a packet to the TUN device, applying L2 headers if necessary.

methods.name: ReadPacket
methods.description: Reads a packet from the TUN device, processing L2 headers and handling ICMPv6 neighbor solicitations.

methods.name: set_file_descriptor
methods.description: Sets the file descriptor for the TUN device.

methods.name: stats_interface
methods.description: Returns the stats interface associated with this exchanger.

methods.name: ApplyL2Headers
methods.description: Adds L2 headers to an L3 packet for transmission over a TAP device.

methods.name: ConsumeL2Headers
methods.description: Removes L2 headers from a received packet and handles ICMPv6 neighbor solicitations.
